name: I WIN!
detailed_description:
I WIN! is a chaotic genre-hopping parody developed by a solo dev who thought, “What if every game idea went into one game?” Then actually did it.

The game is currently in development, with only the maze level playable (and not even finished — thanks, DEV.exe), but many ridiculous and exciting levels are planned ahead.

Expect regular updates as the game progresses toward its release date early in 2026.

Wishlist now to follow the journey and be the first to play when it launches!

---

I WIN! is a comedy parody game poking fun at gamers, AI, gaming companies, and more.

Hit the giant I WIN button for instant glory — skip the grind, unlock tons of achievements, and roll credits immediately. Perfect for gamers who want all the glory with none of the work.

Or, if you’re feeling brave, dive into DEV.exe’s chaotic virtual world — a patchwork of plot holes, buggy code, and snarky remarks.

Explore 7 wild game genres, including a mind-bending maze, Zelda-inspired adventure, brutal platformer, city builder/tower defense, turn-based RPG, match-3, and a space shooter with tech lightyears ahead. Each has quirky twists you’ll need to find and exploit to outwit DEV.

Laugh, rage, and maybe actually play.

short_description: Press the giant "I WIN" button and instantly win — with (almost) all achievements unlocked. Or actually play through seven chaotic levels packed with glitches, jokes, and surprises — including a maze , platformer and other popular genres. I WIN! is the parody game for gamers who just want to laugh.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 7 SP1+, Windows 10, or later
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.0 GHz or better
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Intel HD 4000 or better)
  • Storage: 250 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: Quad-core 2.5 GHz or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU (NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 / AMD Radeon HD 7870 or better)
  • Storage: 250 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
